D-01.title: Two gates rewrite tracked results files on every run
D-01.evidence: checks/verify_brava_corpus_identity.py writes results/phase6_brava_corpus_identity_20260910.json and checks/verify_c3_fallback.py writes results/RESULTS_c3_fallback.txt. The first docstring says it 'modifies no historical artifact' while overwriting a dated record's generated stamp and comparison statuses.
D-01.not_a_data_change: 0 sha256, bytes or nonblank_rows lines differ. Statuses moved to match because the preflight gained all five graphs and its 61-character hash was corrected on 2026-09-10; that is a recorded amendment.
D-01.resolution: Read-only by default was chosen. A plain run of either gate writes nothing, tested by hashing the files before and after. checks/verify_c3_fallback.py writes only with --record, and its routing has a self-test. checks/verify_brava_corpus_identity.py --record writes a new file named for the day and refuses an existing one. The 2026-09-10 record was restored to its committed content; RESULTS_c3_fallback.txt was re-recorded once at current source hashes.

D-02.title: analyse_sample_efficiency 'one swapped pair' is the untied bound
D-02.evidence: tolerance() uses 2/C(n,2). tau-b divides by a smaller number when the target has ties, so one real swap moves tau by more than that (inferred from the tau-b formula, not measured).
D-02.consequence: The gate is stricter than its comment says, so it cannot pass something the comment would reject.

D-03.title: analysis/analyse_betweenness.py prints the boundary share under the label 'tau floor'
D-03.evidence: analysis/analyse_betweenness.py:336 prints w_exact; lines 153-188 of the same file say this conflation was the 2026-09-05 error. results/RESULTS_betweenness.txt shows 0.7100, 0.6535, 0.2628, 0.1562, 0.4353 against the corrected 0.593, 0.571, 0.260, 0.156, 0.418 pinned in checks/verify_pipeline.py.
D-03.consequence: A tracked result file carries the retracted statistic and a false sentence. Downgraded because no consumer was found: tracked code does not read the file, the study cites it only for mismatch counts, and the floors the study and verifier use come from boundary_share()['tau_floor'].
D-03.binding: No live hash check covers this file. The Moran provenance binds analysis/analyse_betweenness_k.py, and the importers take only boundary_share.

fix.what: Prints B['tau_floor'] instead of w_exact under the 'tau floor' label. Regenerated output differs from the recorded one in exactly the five floor lines: 0.7100/0.6535/0.2628/0.1562/0.4353 became 0.5929/0.5714/0.2598/0.1556/0.4181, the floors checks/verify_pipeline.py pins.
fix.checks: checks/verify_buffered_cv.py, checks/verify_docs.py and checks/verify_pipeline.py all exit 0 after the change.

D-04.title: 154 finished buffered CV cells carry the status 'incomplete'
D-04.evidence: Measured against results/phase6_buffered_cv_folds.csv: all 154 are mixes of complete folds with infeasible_lt30 (77) or source_infeasible (77) folds, and the fold file has no ready rows.
D-04.consequence: The label reads as an unfinished run, and analysis/analyse_buffered_cv.py:127 merges these with fully infeasible cells.
D-04.rejected_part: The review's 'fitted folds are discarded silently' is not accepted: probes/probe_buffered_cv.py:963-964 documents the exclusion as deliberate and keeps partial predictions in the checkpoint. Its proposed relabel is also not adopted as stated, because it would change row_sha256 values in a recorded file.

fix.what: Unscored contrasts now say why: unscored_unresolved_buffer 84, unscored_infeasible 39, unscored_partially_infeasible 21, unscored_infeasible+partially_infeasible 12 (was one label on 156 rows). fix.checks: checks/verify_buffered_cv.py, checks/verify_docs.py and checks/verify_pipeline.py all exit 0 after the change.

D-06.title: Modal r* tie-break differs between analysis/analyse.py and two other scripts
D-06.evidence: analysis/analyse.py:239 sorts before idxmax; analysis/analyse_estimators.py:114 and analysis/analyse_objective_horizon.py:106 do not. Measured by running both scripts: 1 tie in 240 calls, and the tie-break changes no mode.

D-07.title: figures/make_fig1.py caption mixes computed numbers with fixed conclusions
D-07.evidence: figures/make_fig1.py:183-191 uses the unpaired across-seed sd, hard-codes 'done at r=1' and 'still climbing at r=3', leaves min(g_vol)/g_bet unguarded, and names no arm.

fix.what: Caption numbers now come from paired per-seed differences, and each verdict from its own rule. Measured on ca-GrQc: the betweenness r1->r3 gain is +0.008 against 2 paired sd = 0.002, so it is ABOVE seed noise, while its eps=0.05 r* is 1. The old caption's 'done at r=1' rested on the unpaired sd and was true only in the eps sense; the new caption states both. Likewise the volatility targets have r*=2 by eps while their r2->r3 hop is still above seed noise. Footer now names the objective arm and that the circles are the mean-curve r*.
fix.checks: checks/verify_buffered_cv.py, checks/verify_docs.py and checks/verify_pipeline.py all exit 0 after the change.

D-13.title: checks/verify_nonbacktracking_local.py's direct-B oracle pairs arcs by position, not identity
D-13.evidence: Its arc list is node-major; build_nonbacktracking_direct (criticality.py:74-79) orders upper triangle then reversals. Measured 2026-11-09: agrees on all four of its fixtures, disagrees on triangle+pendant (L=2: [3,2,3,2] vs true [3,3,2,2]) and on a 5-path.
D-13.consequence: The oracle cannot catch an error on the shapes it is given. Production nb_walk_counts agrees with explicit enumeration on all of these graphs, so no result is affected.

D-14.title: Twelve tracked results files carry absolute local paths
D-14.evidence: results/phase6_5_local/*.json and pilot_2/*.json (10 files; probes/probe_local_predictors.py:72 stores str(p.resolve())), results/phase6_task6_coverage_ledger_20260911.json, and two provenance files under results/phase6_buffered_pre_orbit5_retag_20260910/.

D-15.title: pipeline/fetch_data.py swallows a pin mismatch and rewrites data/manifest.json without that network
D-15.evidence: pipeline/fetch_data.py:140-150: verify_pinned raises inside fetch(); the loop's except Exception prints [FAIL] and continues; the manifest is then written from the successes only.
D-15.consequence: Latent until someone re-runs pipeline/fetch_data.py; a changed upstream file would leave a truncated tracked manifest and exit 0.

D-16.title: checks/verify_robustness_rerun.py passes when it compares nothing

D-16.consequence: A truncated rerun file could pass. The current run fails check 1 for its known reason, so no recorded verdict depends on this.
